visa-preparation.entry_summary: Australia isn't on Cabo Verde's visa-exempt list, and isn't on the list of nationalities that need a visa before arrival from 1 January 2026. All travellers pre-register on the EASE platform and pay the Airport Security Fee (TSA); visa applications are also made on EASE, and a tourist visa can be bought at the border where it applies.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: EASE pre-registration with TSA payment before travel; visa through EASE or at the border (the visa route for Australians isn't spelt out on the pages read).
visa-preparation.before_departure: Pre-register on ease.gov.cv and pay the TSA (valid one year), and confirm the visa route with a Cabo Verde embassy or consulate.

steps.step: Pre-register on EASE and pay the Airport Security Fee (TSA) online.
Check the visa: Australia is not on the visa-exempt list, so a visa is needed; apply through EASE, or confirm with a Cabo Verde embassy or consulate.
Without proof of pre-registration, pay the TSA and, where it applies, buy the tourist visa at the border post on arrival.
